positions.title: TechStart Intern
positions.description:
-	Designed wireframes and contributed to a Serverless architecture for an enterprise application with Sr. Executive and cross-functional stakeholders to facilitate the process of requesting and approving new full-time employees.
-	Developed the front-end and implemented company branding standards for a responsive, mobile-friendly application using Angular and Material Design.
-	Developed locally on Docker using Serverless framework and mocked AWS services using LocalStack to mitigate development costs.
-	Developed proficiency with AWS to store and retrieve essential data needed for the front-end using services like DynamoDB, DynamoDBStreams, API Gateway, and Lambdas.
-	Partnered with customers, Technologists, and Sr. Develops to ensure quality and that customer requirements were met.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Helping People · Angular · Stakeholder Relations · Technical Discussions · Software Design · Oral Communication

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
-	Enriched cloud expenditure data for CloudHealth users by adding collection, processing and cost management supportability to over 15 AWS Services using Ruby on Rails.
-	Reduced the possibility of erroneous data in the CloudHealth web application by restricting users to a list of valid options retrieved from API calls using the AngularJS Framework.
-	Provided a visual medium for quantifying the number of bugs and problems encountered in production per development team by developing a Python program to gather, format and post data to Google Sheets. 
-	Collaborated with UI Designers and UI Architects and to debug and polish the new CloudHealth User Interface.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Python · AngularJS · Kubernetes · Helping People · Ruby on Rails · Technical Discussions · Oral Communication

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
-	Generated dashboards using Python, MySQL, and Grafana software to help clients visually track information such as number of transactions made, fluctuations in stock shares, and net profits.
-	Improve file management of customer data within the company by developing programs that parsed and reformatted files to be compatible with proprietary software.
